conventions.imaginarySign: As printed by Sears (1992): b = b' − i·b'', so Im(b) ≤ 0 for absorbing nuclei. In the crystallographic structure factor F = Σ b·exp(+2πi h·x), use conj(b) (docs/CONVENTIONS.md §5).
conventions.abs2200: Absorption cross section for 2200 m/s neutrons (λ = 1.798 Å).
conventions.energyDependence: Values are thermal bound values. Rows with complex b have resonances and are only valid near 2200 m/s.

citation: Sears, V. F. (1992). Neutron scattering lengths and cross sections. Neutron News 3(3), 26–37. doi:10.1080/10448639208218770
